mapper.select: SELECT * FROM song WHERE id >= (SELECT FLOOR(RAND() * (SELECT MAX(id) FROM song))) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{count}
SELECT * FROM song ORDER BY id LIMIT #{count}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO song(source_id, name, artist, album, cover_url, duration, url, lyric) VALUES(#{sourceId}, #{name}, #{artist}, #{album}, #{coverUrl}, #{duration}, #{url}, #{lyric}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE url = VALUES(url), name = VALUES(name), artist = VALUES(artist), album = VALUES(album), cover_url = VALUES(cover_url), duration = VALUES(duration), lyric = COALESCE(VALUES(lyric), lyric)
